description: This source file defines API routes for managing JIRA synchronization within a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for queuing syncs, listing sync records, retrieving specific sync records, retrying sync operations, and handling JIRA webhooks. The code interacts with database models, performs audit logging, and manages background tasks for asynchronous processing.
